[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Cherry pickup II** [LC 1463 · Cherry Pickup II](https://leetcode.com/problems/cherry-pickup-ii/){difficulty="Hard"}

The problem already synchronises the robots: after $k$ moves both are in row $k$. The state is the row and the two columns. They share a cell exactly when the columns match. A suffix, "most cherries from this row downward", needs no unreachable marker, because every pair of columns is a legal place to be standing. The forward form has to mark the columns a robot cannot yet have reached.

[Solved in full in @sec-gd-p4-cherry2.]{.card-link}
